cards.name: ChomChom Roller (Original)
cards.badge: Good · under $25 · Amazon's No. 1 pet hair remover
cards.price: $24.99 everyday · $17–$20 on deal days · $12–$15 is a historic low (list $27.99–$31.99)
cards.buy_if: you have a couch, a car seat or a duvet and a pet that sheds; it is the cheapest thing on this page that changes daily life.
cards.skip_if: you want it for carpet pile or loose blankets — it needs a taut, firm surface (a vacuum or an Uproot Cleaner Pro does carpet).
cards.owners: 4.5 stars across 190,000-plus ratings, as reported by Reader's Digest. Praise: a cushion cleared in 30 seconds, nothing to refill. Complaints: a week to learn the stroke, and the button pops open under your thumb.

cards.name: Neakasa P1 Pro Grooming Vacuum Kit
cards.price: $83–$85 on sale in 2026 · $70–$75 is the floor (list $130)
cards.buy_if: your dog or cat sheds enough that you brush weekly and the fur still ends up everywhere; it turns the brush into a vacuum.
cards.skip_if: you have a big double-coated dog and want one-pass grooming (the 1-liter cup fills fast — the P2 Pro's 2-liter cup is the fix), or you want a full shave-down tool.
cards.owners: Dogster scores it 4.9/5. Owners praise that fur goes straight into the bin and that vacuum-averse dogs accept it after a few short sessions. Complaints: emptying the cup mid-groom, and the clipper is for trims, not shaves.

cards.name: Whisker Litter-Robot 4
cards.badge: Best · $699 · the internet-famous robot litter box
cards.price: $699 all of 2026 · $799 with a 3-year warranty · Costco bundle $699.99 · reconditioned $599
cards.chip: Up to 4 cats · app · no subscription
cards.buy_if: you have one to four cats, hate scooping, or travel — the sealed drawer and the app are what 7,000-plus verified owners keep praising.
cards.skip_if: you have a kitten under 3 lb (semi-automatic mode until then), a cat that hates enclosed boxes (see the open-top Neakasa M1), or you can wait for Black Friday bundles.
cards.owners: 4.4/5 across 7,000-plus verified reviews on Whisker's own site; Catster 4.6, Hepper 4.85. Praise: odor control, hands-off, quiet. Complaints: the price, occasional false 'drawer full' readings (wipe the sensors), OdorTrap refills add up.
